# MiniCAD source provenance

Source is the MiniCAD document, editor, scene, text, viewport, serialization, node and D3D11 rendering subset of https://github.com/CHMOSE023/MiniCAD at commit `9740e7fbc288f1ea5a71af2b89503fce1496389c` (MiniCAD 0.8.4). This directory supersedes the initial MiniDWG-only subset.

MiniCAD copyright and MIT license are retained in LICENSE. ACadSharp provenance and MIT license are retained in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. This subset uses the upstream source and generated data model with its original CMake library definitions. The surrounding application, fonts, solid kernel and test assets are outside this source subset.

Wanluo's read-only diagnostic adapter is in DrawingReader. The persistent document, editor and D3D11 viewport bridge is in CadKernel. Local patches add a system TrueType display fallback for unavailable SHX files, default new drawings to millimetres, and preserve insertion units/base points across format changes. Original text-style metadata stays in the source document. SMLib and upstream font assets are excluded.

Interaction patches on 2026-11-13 add click-release-click window/crossing selection, additive selection with Shift removal, and a shared selection phase for command-first Move/Copy/Rotate/Scale/Mirror/Erase/Explode. Enter/Space finish line and polyline input. Circle, rectangle and three-point arc finish after one valid construction. Esc cancels transient selection/tool state while command-stack edits remain available to Undo.

A follow-up fix makes rectangle selection uniformly two-click. Empty-space button-down anchors the first corner, movement with either button state updates the preview, button-up retains it, and only the next button-down commits. The former 2-pixel drag threshold and release-to-commit branch are removed. Point selection uses the press location so small motion before release preserves the clicked target.

Cold-start document creation removes the renderer-presence guard in DocumentManager.New. Document and layout creation can run before attaching a native viewport. The Wanluo bridge establishes the new drawing's default units, font and view before marking that initial blank state clean.

The later 2026-11-13 tool batch adds native dimension export and semantic round-trip restoration, table and jogged-dimension compatibility blocks, table picking, hatch parameter recovery, paper-space ownership for new text, layout undo activation checks, and editor parameter/dialog hooks. The WPF forms and C ABI adapter remain in StandaloneWorkbench and CadKernel. These changes extend the vendored subset while retaining the upstream license and provenance.

On 2026-11-14, named style integration adds current text/multiline style header round trips, persistence for unused named text styles, reuse of imported Standard multiline styles, preservation of existing multiline style snapshots when definitions change, and corrected CAD square-cap/joint flag mapping. The document-owned WPF style commands and forms are in CadKernel and StandaloneWorkbench.

The subsequent 2026-11-14 integration remaps clipboard layers, line types, text styles, nested blocks and attributes across documents with dependency snapshots and atomic paste undo. It preserves source references after document closure, assigns newly defined block inserts to current layer/space, resolves nested insert caches, persists located external-reference paths, and marks exported xref-dependent symbol records. Source-based exchange also updates line type patterns and drawing variables, and synchronizes named text/multiline style renames and safe deletion while retaining original handles. The WPF drawing-settings, point-style, reference and standard-view interfaces are maintained outside this vendored directory.

The layout continuation adds physical page dimensions, page-setup-preserving layout rename/copy/order export, stable paper-space mapping across file-format changes, viewport locking round trips, explicit DXF VPLAYER handle input, viewport property/grip/translation editing, and current-space bounds for zoom. Existing layout object handles and metadata are reused on source-based saves. The adapter-owned two-click viewport tool and undoable layout command are in CadKernel, with WPF forms in StandaloneWorkbench.

The viewport-content continuation adds an opt-in tool navigation hook before global paper-camera handling. The adapter-owned navigation tool pans and zooms model content within a fixed paper frame, respects viewport/layer locks, and commits each gesture as a geometry undo unit.

The polygon-viewport continuation stores frame-relative clipping vertices, draws and tests polygon boundaries, clips deferred dashes, and clips convex/concave fill content using convex decomposition. Exchange reads straight closed polyline clipping boundaries and writes native VIEWPORT boundary handles with independent paper-space polylines. Source rewrites reuse unshared boundaries and remove orphaned owned clipping geometry. Unsupported curved boundaries retain their source metadata during source-based saves. Interactive redraw/restore tools are in CadKernel and WPF.

On 2026-11-15, detailed viewport clipping reuses convex boundary decomposition for textured triangle streams with interpolated UV/color/depth. Raster fragments share their original decoded image. Boundary glyphs expand through GlyphMeshLibrary and are clipped into line/fill geometry, while fully contained glyphs keep instancing. Existing outside-wipe text semantics remain available. Import recognizes floating/clipped 1:1 viewports before applying the paper-main-viewport heuristic.

Raster exchange now emits a default two-point DXF image boundary, assigns image definitions to their dictionary owner, and records actual pixel dimensions with matching per-pixel placement vectors. Header-only image-size queries avoid allocating another decoded bitmap during export. Source image display/crop parameters are retained when pixel metadata requires rewriting.

On 2026-11-16, viewport clipping gains circular and axis-aligned elliptical boundaries. The scene stores the curve kind, uses analytic containment and 256-segment display/clipping, and retains it through cloning and internal serialization. Exchange recognizes centered full circles/axis-aligned ellipses and writes native CIRCLE/ELLIPSE clipping entities, preserving unshared source handles and paper-space ownership. Rotated ellipses, arc-composed polylines and spline clipping remain outside this integration. The two-click tools and WPF boundary-type selection live in CadKernel and StandaloneWorkbench.

The subsequent viewport-edit integration adds a per-document transient maximized model-edit context while retaining the selected paper layout and its camera. Existing editing tools target model space, with viewport-frozen layer filtering in display, picking, snapping and nested drawing/highlighting. Temporary camera navigation leaves the source viewport parameters intact. Returning restores the paper camera; document switching retains each session and layout switching leaves it. The original clipping boundary is shown as a transient model-space outline using an inverse paper-to-model transform. Adapter/WPF commands expose VPMAX and VPMIN. In-place double-click editing and non-plan viewport editing remain pending.

The in-place continuation adds double-click/MSPACE paper-viewport editing and PSPACE exit, with a shared scene and undo history. A separate interaction camera maps model input to the original layout, while a passive paper editor draws the layout and an interaction-only renderer draws model feedback. The D3D11 backend supports RGBA layer compositing with premultiplied alpha. Existing polygon clipping limits the feedback texture, picking geometry and snap candidates, including concave/circular boundaries and visible construction lines. Locked navigation operates on the paper camera; unlocked pan/zoom updates the viewport through gesture-sized undo commands. Layout switching, document switching, cache lifetime and save round trips are handled by the adapter. Non-plan viewport editing and unsupported curved clipping boundaries remain pending.

On 2026-11-17, orthographic non-plan viewport composition retains the source view direction and three-dimensional target, constructs AutoCAD-compatible arbitrary axes including the 1/64 polar cap, and projects XYZ model geometry into paper coordinates. Internal serialization and layout clones retain these fields. Exchange restores display-coordinate centers, targets, twist and directions in DWG/DXF saves. Spatial viewports conservatively admit model candidates before existing clipping. Perspective projection and non-plan viewport editing remain pending.

The subsequent non-plan viewport navigation integration adds a shared paper-displacement-to-model-vector inverse and paper-point unprojection onto the observation plane. Adapter-owned content pan/zoom and clipping reframing preserve XYZ centers, including undo for Z-only movement. Viewport parameter changes preserve center elevation. Perspective status is retained through import, cloning, internal serialization and export, while orthographic navigation rejects perspective views. Capture/focus loss cancels unfinished content navigation. Non-plan drawing/editing and perspective projection remain pending.

The working-plane continuation adds document-owned orthonormal model UCS data, internal serialization, model UCS header exchange and explicit DXF UCS header variables. Camera rays intersect the selected working plane. Input resolution, grid fallback, orthographic/polar constraints, dynamic input and absolute/relative XYZ coordinates use this plane while object snaps retain actual 3D positions. Line and point drawing plus move/copy support the plane; other tool representations remain pending and report that limitation. Move commits retain double-precision XYZ displacement, including pure Z movement. WPF settings and UCS VIEW/WORLD commands live in the adapter, preserving the origin for UCS VIEW.

On 2026-11-18, circle and arc geometry retain WCS centers and OCS normals throughout working-plane drawing, feature snaps, projected picking, grip updates, rigid transforms and move/copy undo. Curve angles remain canonical OCS parameters. Internal serialization marks WCS centers and migrates legacy OCS centers. CAD exchange converts centers between WCS and OCS while writing native CIRCLE/ARC entities. Grip resolution follows the curve plane, and the shared grip command preserves the complete circle snapshot. XY intersection tools retain their planar solver and filter spatial targets pending spatial intersection support. Adapter/WPF updates expose circle-center Z and guard parameter callbacks after disposal.
